title: Snippet added after first build is not applied without --clean
setup: mkdir -p vm && (cd vm && . "$QNX_SDP/qnxsdp-env.sh" >/dev/null && mkqnximage --type=qemu --arch=x86_64 --ssh-ident=none --noprompt >/dev/null 2>&1) && echo hi > vm/hello_note.txt && printf '[perms=0644] /var/hello_note.txt=%s/vm/hello_note.txt\n' "$PWD" > vm/local/snippets/data_files.custom
source: our own install notes of 2026-11-14 (not in this repository)
